sloka: शोणितार्द्रो महाकायो राक्षसो भीमविक्रमः।युद्धायाभिमुखो भूयो मनश्चके महाबलः ।। ६.६७.९१ ।।
transliteration: śoṇitārdro mahākāyo rākṣaso bhīmavikramaḥ।yuddhāyābhimukho bhūyo manaścake mahābalaḥ ।। 6.67.91 ।।

translations.english: Great hero Kumbhakarna, devoid of ears and nose drenched in blood shone like a mountain in springs.
